name: TikTok Scraper
description: TikTok scraper for Python and the command line: public profile stats (followers, likes, videos, bio) and per-video metrics (views, likes, comments, shares, saves, sound, hashtags) as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: profiles
commands.help: public profile stats for one or more TikTok accounts
commands.description: Public TikTok profile stats — followers, likes, videos, bio.

inputs.name: usernames
inputs.description: Handles (with or without @) or profile URLs.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many profiles to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered profiles.

commands.name: videos
commands.help: views, likes, comments, shares and saves of one or more videos
commands.description: Per-video TikTok metrics — views, likes, comments, shares, saves.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many videos to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered videos.
